champions.shape: slender upright shark-faced duelist with swept-back head fin, two short crescent nacre forearm blades pointing down, narrow dark violet sash, exposed pale sea-green chest and asymmetric fin greaves
champions.kit: Every third completed hit punishes an enemy preparing a basic attack.
champions.kit_pt: O terceiro golpe ganha força contra inimigos preparando um ataque básico.
champions.weapon: Paired short forward nacre fin blades on the gauntlets; no hanging hook or chain.
champions.victory: Alternating torso sway with both blades tucked upward.
champions.native_refinement: The illustrative crescent blades are adapted to forward shell fins to distinguish this silhouette from Hook Brawler.

champions.shape: tall lean manta-faced female amphibious lancer, broad lateral head fins, short three-pronged ivory trident carried upright close to right shoulder, coral-colored segmented waist armor, one spiral shell shoulder guard
champions.kit: Every third thrust pierces one enemy standing closely behind the target.
champions.kit_pt: O terceiro golpe atravessa um inimigo próximo atrás do alvo.
champions.weapon: Compact upright ivory trident with a contrasting spiral shell shoulder.
champions.victory: Raises the trident and bows the head.

champions.shape: short deep-sea fighter with flattened hammerhead-like head, very long compact right forearm ending in a huge faceted saltstone gauntlet, tiny free left hand, ochre cloth wraps, dark olive sea skin, squat webbed feet
champions.kit: Heavy impacts add capped damage based on the target maximum health.
champions.kit_pt: Golpes pesados causam dano adicional limitado pela vida-base do alvo.
champions.weapon: One oversized faceted saltstone gauntlet; free left hand stays small.
champions.projectile: None; salt chips and a small ground ring.
champions.victory: Holds the heavy fist overhead with a weighted knee bounce.

champions.shape: small round-faced fish folk slinger with a wide folded fin hood, two round pearl pouches at hips, a compact curved shell sling in the right hand, rust-brown short cape and pale turquoise skin
champions.kit: Every third impact shatters into a small bounded splash around the target.
champions.kit_pt: A terceira pérola estilhaça e atinge poucos inimigos próximos do alvo.
champions.weapon: Curved shell sling and two round hip pearl pouches.
champions.projectile: Rounded pearl with nacre ring, soft water trail and fragment impact.
champions.victory: Raises the sling and rolls the wrist above a small hip sway.

champions.shape: upright eel-faced huntress with long narrow jaw, short back fin, compact hand-held wooden harpoon launcher with a clearly visible long ivory barbed bolt, cream chest straps and dark sea-plum coat
champions.kit: Barbed bolts apply one non-stacking bleed family.
champions.kit_pt: Arpões farpados deixam sangramento que não acumula com outro sangramento.
champions.weapon: Wood-and-nacre hand-held launcher with barbed bolt and branch-B back bolts.
champions.projectile: Slender barbed ivory bolt with a wooden shaft.
champions.victory: Presents the launcher and tilts the shoulders.

champions.shape: broad-necked amphibious herald with three small chin fins, large spiral conch horn held near chest in both hands, flat scalloped shoulder mantle, ivory head stripe and deep green skin
champions.kit: Periodic announced conch pulses slow a bounded group near the primary target.
champions.kit_pt: Pulsos anunciados da concha retardam um grupo limitado perto do alvo.
champions.weapon: Flared spiral conch held at chest height; branched mouth/ribs change with Evolution.
champions.projectile: Spiral shell pulse; delayed Slow has a separate authoritative cue.
champions.victory: Holds the conch in both hands and nods to its rhythm.

champions.shape: very tall thin angler-faced lamplighter with short bent fishing-lure head fin, an amber glass lantern inside a cage of ivory shell ribs on a compact staff, dark indigo split robe and pale green hands
champions.kit: A delayed light pulse strikes a locked visible ground point; enemies can walk out.
champions.kit_pt: O farol anuncia um ponto fixo antes do pulso; inimigos podem sair da área.
champions.weapon: Amber lantern enclosed by shell ribs on a short staff; living lure on the head.
champions.projectile: Amber faceted shard for basics; the special marks a fixed ground center before resolving.
champions.victory: Raises the lantern and follows it with a lifted head.

champions.shape: graceful amphibious healer with two lateral soft head fins, an open half-shell chalice held in both hands with a small suspended pearl, overlapping white nacre skirt panels, plum shoulder scarf and sea-green skin
champions.kit: Healing leaves a short non-stacking echo consumed by the next nonlethal health hit.
champions.kit_pt: A cura deixa um eco curto consumido pelo próximo golpe não letal na vida.
champions.weapon: Half-shell chalice, open fins and one suspended pearl.
champions.projectile: Small pearlescent foam cluster; the healing echo remains visible on the patient.
champions.victory: Presents the pearl with both arms and turns the upper body gently.

champions.shape: small upright living wood creature with a broad split seed-pod launcher enclosing its right forearm, three large ivory seeds visible inside the green jaws of the pod, asymmetrical curled leaf crown, squat root feet and ochre bark chest, no face mask or mushrooms
champions.kit: Every third completed hit plants one bounded non-stacking seed mark consumed by the next allied melee strike.
champions.kit_pt: O terceiro disparo planta uma marca consumida pelo próximo golpe corpo a corpo de outro aliado.
champions.weapon: Split living forearm pod with three visible seeds and animated jaws.
champions.projectile: Ivory seed with green pod tip; its shared mark has bounded public duration.
champions.victory: Bobs its leaf crown and lifts the seed pod.
